Corollary

↗ prop:6-3

1. ch6:6.4Every proper affine subspace of $\mathbb {R}^n$ has measure zero in $\mathbb {R}^n$.

Proof

\sketch If $\dim S=n-1$, choose a coordinate axis not parallel to $S$. Then $S$ is the graph of an affine function in the remaining coordinates and is null by Proposition 1. If $\dim S<n-1$, embed $S$ in an affine hyperplane and apply Proposition C.18(b).

□
